title: Safe use in NZ and your next steps quiz

questions.question: An HR note has no name but describes the only payroll officer in a small office. Is it safe to treat as anonymous?

answers.text: Yes, removing a name always anonymises it.
answers.feedback: People can be identified from combinations of details.

answers.text: No, the remaining details may identify the person.
answers.feedback: Correct. Use a fully invented practice situation instead.

answers.text: Yes, if it is pasted into a paid plan.
answers.feedback: A paid plan does not make identifiable data anonymous.

questions.question: A draft cites a source for a business claim. What should you check?

answers.text: Only whether the link looks official.
answers.feedback: An official-looking link can be wrong or irrelevant.

answers.text: Whether the source exists, is current, and supports that exact claim.
answers.feedback: Correct. Open the source and verify the claim.

answers.text: Whether a second AI repeats the claim.
answers.feedback: Repeated AI output is not independent evidence.

questions.question: What belongs in a practical team AI policy? Select all that apply.

answers.text: A named owner and incident process.
answers.feedback: Correct. People need to know who owns the policy and handles mistakes.
Correct. Staff need a usable boundary before entering information.
Outputs must be checked before use.
Correct. Assign review and final approval to people.

questions.question: A builder’s source says “proposed start, subject to approval”. The draft gives a guaranteed start. What should happen?

answers.text: Keep the guarantee to sound confident.
answers.feedback: Confidence does not justify changing the commitment.

answers.text: Restore the condition and have a person approve the corrected draft.
answers.feedback: Correct. Preserve the meaning of the source and review the correction.

answers.text: Remove the source so the draft reads better.
answers.feedback: The source is needed to verify the draft.

questions.question: What does this course-completion certificate represent?

answers.feedback: This is independent training with no Anthropic certification.

answers.text: TheColab course completion recorded by the platform.
answers.feedback: Correct. It records completion of this TheColab course.

answers.text: Permission to upload any business information.
answers.feedback: Data approval remains a separate workplace responsibility.
